decisions.reason: As a closely related extension of the firm's fluid-handling and machine-tool support know-how, it fits its absorptive capacity and service-led portfolio well, so despite limited website evidence the firm would more likely refine and retain it than withdraw it.

This filter product builds directly on the firm's established filtration expertise, making it easy to learn from, improve through in-house R&D, and integrate into broader customer systems, which argues for keeping it on the market.

Because this gravity band coolant filter is very close to the firm's core offer and can be supported through its modular engineering, production, spare parts and service base, management would likely keep it unless sales proved clearly weak.
